description: Claims and critiques about diet, metabolism, and health outcomes — where correlational epidemiology is common and easily overclaimed as causal, and industry funding of research is a well-documented, real source of bias.

critique_species.name: StudyDesignCritique
required_evidence: The specific study design detail being disputed

critique_species.name: ObservationalVsRCTCritique
required_evidence: Whether the cited study was observational or a randomized controlled trial, and why that matters for the claim being made

critique_species.name: SampleSizeCritique
required_evidence: Sample size, and a power calculation if available

critique_species.name: IndustryFundingCritique
required_evidence: The documented funding source or disclosure statement
